kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Power (gas turbines, nucléaire, hydro, steam) : pic demande data centers AI + renouvellement flotte vieillissante US.
kpis.description_en: Power segment (gas turbines, nuclear, hydro, steam): peak demand from AI data centers + aging US fleet replacement.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Wind (onshore + offshore + services) : segment encore en pertes opérationnelles, restructuration en cours.
kpis.description_en: Wind segment (onshore + offshore + services): segment still in op losses, restructuring in progress.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Electrification (grid solutions, transformers, switchgear) : exposition grid investment, tirée par AI data centers et transition énergétique.
kpis.description_en: Electrification (grid solutions, transformers, switchgear): grid investment exposure, AI data centers + energy transition driven.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog total (équipement + services) : visibilité revenu sur 5-7 ans, dont Power Equipment backlog quasi doublé en 2 ans.
kpis.description_en: Total backlog (equipment + services): 5-7 year revenue visibility, Power Equipment backlog nearly doubled in 2 years.
